title: Yummy Juicy Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A winey, juicy solo dinner dish featuring lemongrass and a mother sauce base with Mediterranean friendly flavors.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the bruised lemongrass with olive oil and grill alongside the skewers for 2 minutes.
Grill the skewers for 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef reaches 135 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Meanwhile, mix the tomato paste with 2 tablespoons of water to make a mother sauce base.
Serve the skewers with the mother sauce base spooned over the top.
